fsm_states_mac_tx.name: TX_IDLE
fsm_states_mac_tx.description: MAC has no frame to transmit; TX_EN held de-asserted; TXD driven to don't-care; CRS / COL monitored for medium activity (half-duplex).

fsm_states_mac_tx.name: TX_DEFER
fsm_states_mac_tx.description: (Half-duplex only) CRS is asserted; MAC waits until the medium is idle for at least one inter-frame gap (96 BT) before proceeding to TX_PREAMBLE.

fsm_states_mac_tx.name: TX_IFG
fsm_states_mac_tx.description: Counting down the 96-bit-time inter-frame gap after the previous frame; TX_EN held de-asserted.

fsm_states_mac_tx.name: TX_PREAMBLE
fsm_states_mac_tx.description: Assert TX_EN synchronously with the first nibble (or byte) of the 7-octet preamble (0x55). Counter steps through 14 nibbles (or 7 bytes) of preamble.

fsm_states_mac_tx.name: TX_SFD
fsm_states_mac_tx.description: Drive the 1-octet SFD (0xD5) — 2 nibbles or 1 byte — and arm the FCS engine to start CRC-32 computation on the next octet (DA byte 0).

fsm_states_mac_tx.name: TX_DA_SA_TYPE_DATA
fsm_states_mac_tx.description: Drive Destination Address (6 B) + Source Address (6 B) + Type/Length (2 B) + Payload (≥ 46 B after pad) onto TXD; CRC engine updates each cycle. TX_EN stays asserted.

fsm_states_mac_tx.name: TX_PAD
fsm_states_mac_tx.description: If the frame length excluding FCS is < 60 B, zero-pad with 0x00 octets until 60 B have been driven post-SFD. CRC engine continues over pad bytes.

fsm_states_mac_tx.name: TX_FCS
fsm_states_mac_tx.description: Drive the 4 octets of FCS (CRC-32 result, MSB-byte first, LSB-bit first within each byte) onto TXD; TX_EN still asserted.

fsm_states_mac_tx.name: TX_EPD
fsm_states_mac_tx.description: De-assert TX_EN before the next TX_CLK edge after the final FCS nibble; PHY emits End-of-Frame delimiter per its PMD class (e.g. /T//R/ for 100BASE-X).

fsm_states_mac_tx.name: TX_BACKOFF
fsm_states_mac_tx.description: (Half-duplex only) On collision, send JAM pattern, then compute backoff = random(0, 2^min(N,10)) × 512 BT for attempt number N (1-16), wait, and return to TX_DEFER. After 16 attempts, abort with Excessive Collisions.

fsm_states_mac_rx.name: RX_IDLE
fsm_states_mac_rx.description: Waiting for CRS or RX_DV from the PHY. RXD ignored.

fsm_states_mac_rx.name: RX_PREAMBLE_LOCK
fsm_states_mac_rx.description: RX_DV asserted; scanning incoming RXD nibbles for the SFD nibble pattern 0xD (last nibble of SFD = 1101). Until SFD is found, accumulate preamble bytes.

fsm_states_mac_rx.name: RX_SFD
fsm_states_mac_rx.description: SFD nibble (0xD) detected; arm CRC-32 engine and start byte-aligned capture into the frame buffer beginning with DA byte 0.

fsm_states_mac_rx.name: RX_FRAME
fsm_states_mac_rx.description: Stream RXD nibbles (or bytes) into the receive FIFO, MAC client framing, and CRC engine. Track byte count for min/max enforcement.

fsm_states_mac_rx.name: RX_FCS_CHECK
fsm_states_mac_rx.description: RX_DV de-asserted (PHY signalled end-of-frame). Compare last 4 captured octets against the CRC-32 of DA + SA + Type/Length + Payload + Pad. On mismatch raise an FCS-error indication.

fsm_states_mac_rx.name: RX_DELIVER
fsm_states_mac_rx.description: FCS good and (length within 64-1518 B for untagged, or 64-1522 B for VLAN-tagged): deliver MAC client data + (DA, SA, Type/Length) tuple to the LLC / IP / VLAN layer.

fsm_states_mac_rx.name: RX_ERROR
fsm_states_mac_rx.description: RX_ER asserted, FCS bad, runt (< 64 B), giant (> 1518/1522 B), or False-Carrier (RXD = 0x1110 with RX_DV = 0 and RX_ER = 1): discard frame, increment the appropriate error counter.

fsm_states_csma_cd_half_duplex.name: Sense
fsm_states_csma_cd_half_duplex.description: Monitor CRS. If asserted, defer; if not asserted for ≥ 96 BT, proceed.

fsm_states_csma_cd_half_duplex.name: Transmit
fsm_states_csma_cd_half_duplex.description: Drive preamble..FCS onto TXD with TX_EN asserted; sample COL each TX_CLK.

fsm_states_csma_cd_half_duplex.name: Collision
fsm_states_csma_cd_half_duplex.description: COL asserted while TX_EN is asserted: immediately transmit a 32-bit JAM pattern, then enter Backoff. If the collision was detected after 512 BT into the frame it is a Late Collision (no backoff retry; just abort).

fsm_states_csma_cd_half_duplex.name: Backoff
fsm_states_csma_cd_half_duplex.description: Truncated-binary-exponential: backoff slots = uniform-random(0, 2^min(N,10)) where N = attempt # (1..16); each slot = 512 BT. Wait then return to Sense.

fsm_states_csma_cd_half_duplex.name: Abort
fsm_states_csma_cd_half_duplex.description: After 16 unsuccessful attempts, abort with Excessive Collisions error; raise a MAC error indication to the upper layer.

fsm_states_mdio_master_clause22.name: MDIO_IDLE
fsm_states_mdio_master_clause22.description: MDC running; MDIO driven high (or high-Z observed as 1 due to PHY pull-up).

fsm_states_mdio_master_clause22.name: MDIO_PRE
fsm_states_mdio_master_clause22.description: STA drives 32 logic-1 bits on MDIO during 32 MDC cycles to wake the PHY (may be suppressed if BMSR bit 1.6 indicates preamble suppression).

fsm_states_mdio_master_clause22.name: MDIO_ST_OP
fsm_states_mdio_master_clause22.description: Drive ST (01) + OP (10 read / 01 write) — 4 MDC cycles, MSB first.

fsm_states_mdio_master_clause22.name: MDIO_PHYAD
fsm_states_mdio_master_clause22.description: Drive PHYAD[4:0] MSB first over 5 MDC cycles.

fsm_states_mdio_master_clause22.name: MDIO_REGAD
fsm_states_mdio_master_clause22.description: Drive REGAD[4:0] MSB first over 5 MDC cycles.

fsm_states_mdio_master_clause22.name: MDIO_TA
fsm_states_mdio_master_clause22.description: Write: drive 10. Read: tri-state for the first bit and let the PHY drive 0 on the second.

fsm_states_mdio_master_clause22.name: MDIO_DATA
fsm_states_mdio_master_clause22.description: 16 MDC cycles. Write: STA drives data bit 15 → bit 0 MSB first. Read: PHY drives data bit 15 → bit 0.

fsm_states_mdio_master_clause22.name: MDIO_DONE
fsm_states_mdio_master_clause22.description: Return to MDIO_IDLE; MDIO floats to logic-1.

fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.name: AN_DISABLE
fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.description: AutoNeg disabled (BMCR 0.12 = 0). Use manual speed + duplex settings.

fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.name: AN_ENABLE
fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.description: AutoNeg enabled. Reset state machine; arm AN_TRANSMIT_DISABLE.

fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.name: AN_ABILITY_DETECT
fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.description: Begin transmitting FLP bursts encoding ANAR (reg 4) Base Page. Listen for FLP bursts from the partner.

fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.name: AN_ACK_DETECT
fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.description: Once at least one full Base Page received, set Acknowledge bit, re-send Base Page until partner acknowledges back.

fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.name: AN_COMPLETE_ACK
fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.description: Both ends have acknowledged. If either side has Next-Page bit set, transition to NEXT_PAGE_WAIT; else proceed to IDLE_DETECT.

fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.name: AN_NEXT_PAGE_WAIT
fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.description: Exchange Next Page messages (one or more) until both sides clear Next-Page bit.

fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.name: AN_IDLE_DETECT
fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.description: Stop FLP transmission; expect a quiet period; resolve the highest common ability via priority table; configure PHY accordingly.

fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.name: AN_LINK_OK
fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.description: Move to the negotiated PMA / PMD; BMSR bit 1.5 set; data signaling begins. BMCR 0.9 (Restart AutoNeg) returns the FSM to AN_ABILITY_DETECT.

fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.name: AN_PARALLEL_DETECT
fsm_states_auto_negotiation_clause28.description: Fallback when partner does not emit FLP bursts: detect partner's data-link integrity tone (10BASE-T NLP or 100BASE-TX scrambled idle or 100BASE-T4 link beat) and bring up the link in that PMA only (no duplex negotiation; default to half-duplex).

fsm_hints.trigger: Power-up -> ADDRESSING_DCP -> CONNECT_AR -> PARAMETERIZATION -> APPLICATION_READY -> DATA_EXCHANGE -> RUN. Addressing must complete (name + IP) before the controller can Connect.
fsm_hints.rule: Cyclic data starts only after ApplicationReady; the consumer uses IOPS + Cycle Counter + Data Status + watchdog to judge validity.
fsm_hints.abort: A watchdog miss or AR abort returns the device toward addressing/connect; alarms set the Station Problem Indicator.

anti_deadlock_rule: The watchdog (data-hold) timer bounds how long a consumer trusts stale data; a miss forces a defined invalid state rather than a hang. AR abort cleanly tears down all CRs.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On power-up the device brings up the Ethernet link, ensures its DCP-assigned NameOfStation + IP, then waits for the IO-Controller's CL-RPC Connect, completes parameterization, signals ApplicationReady, and enters cyclic data exchange.

default_ready_state_recommendation.before_data_exchange: Submodule outputs in the substitute/safe state; IOPS = BAD until parameterized and ApplicationReady.
default_ready_state_recommendation.in_data_exchange: IOPS = GOOD for valid produced data; DataValid set in APDU Data Status.

configurations.name: CC-B device
configurations.description: CC-A + LLDP/SNMP topology & diagnosis + MRP redundancy.

configurations.name: CC-C device
configurations.description: CC-B + IRT hardware scheduling + PTCP sync (motion control).

timing_dependency_rule: MII TX path is synchronous to TX_CLK (PHY-sourced, 25 MHz @100 Mb/s or 2.5 MHz @10 Mb/s). MII RX path is synchronous to RX_CLK (PHY-sourced, may be recovered from received data or a nominal clock). Per Clause 22.2.2.2, RX_CLK and TX_CLK are NOT required to maintain any guaranteed phase relationship. GMII TX path is synchronous to GTX_CLK (MAC-sourced, 125 MHz); GMII RX path is synchronous to RX_CLK (PHY-sourced, 125 MHz). MDC is asynchronous with respect to TX_CLK and RX_CLK; the MDC frequency may differ from any data-path clock.

fsm_states_startup.name: POWER_UP
fsm_states_startup.description: Device boots; Ethernet link comes up (auto-negotiation); MAC active.

fsm_states_startup.name: ADDRESSING_DCP
fsm_states_startup.description: Device has or is assigned NameOfStation + IP via DCP (Set/Hello); the IO-Controller resolves the configured name (DCP-Identify by name).

fsm_states_startup.name: CONNECT_AR
fsm_states_startup.description: IO-Controller sends CL-RPC Connect.req with the expected configuration; IO-Device validates modules/submodules and answers Connect.res; IO-CR/Record-Data-CR/Alarm-CR created.

fsm_states_startup.name: PARAMETERIZATION
fsm_states_startup.description: IO-Controller writes parameter records to each submodule (Write) and signals ParameterEnd.

fsm_states_startup.name: APPLICATION_READY
fsm_states_startup.description: IO-Device signals ApplicationReady (DControl/CControl) when its modules are parameterized.

fsm_states_startup.name: DATA_EXCHANGE
fsm_states_startup.description: Cyclic IO-CR frames flow at the send clock; IOPS/IOCS valid; APDU Cycle Counter running; watchdog armed. AR is 'in data exchange'.

fsm_states_startup.name: RUN
fsm_states_startup.description: Alarms exchanged on events; acyclic Read/Write on demand; diagnosis maintained.

fsm_states_startup.name: ERROR_ABORT
fsm_states_startup.description: Watchdog timeout, CL-RPC AR abort, or fatal diagnosis tears down the AR; device returns toward ADDRESSING/CONNECT to re-establish.
